evidence: SOURCE/FIXTURE only: published C-canvas/C-session failure templates from hanaworlds-contracts@2.7.0 fixtures/world-error, answered by test peers and carried through the real Cordis HTTP routes; no real world, Canvas, Workshop or Adapter was read.

readPath.thrown: HTTP status 409 body.contractError: the peer's whole public Error; body.error stays the bare code (or the existing prefixed text) for older readers
readPath.returned: a Workshop envelope relayed by /api-hanaworlds-workshop/invoke keeps its error at body.result.error
readPath.panels: a build route whose follow-up Canvas panel read was refused keeps the build result and adds body.panelContractError beside body.panelError

Canvas refusal of a panel read names the bound world
